name: ManageEngine PAM360
summary: PAM360 publishes annual English-edition subscription prices from $7,995 for 10 administrators and 25 keys to $49,995 for 200 administrators and 1,000 keys. A free edition covers one administrator and 10 resources with no expiry date, and a 30-day trial is offered.

facts.text: PAM360 is licensed by the number of administrators and keys, and password users and password auditors are unlimited.
A single license covers a high availability setup with a secondary server, and one application gateway is bundled with each license.
The vault encrypts stored credentials with AES-256 and applies role-based access permissions.
Recorded sessions can be archived as video files, and a session shadowing feature lets a supervisor watch a privileged user's activity.
The privilege elevation feature gives domain accounts higher privileges only when required and can revoke them automatically after a set period.

plans.name: Free Edition
plans.notes: Valid forever, with no expiry date.

plans.name: Subscription, 10 administrators and 25 keys
plans.notes: English edition. Includes annual maintenance and support. The multilingual edition costs $9,595.

plans.name: Perpetual, 10 administrators and 25 keys
plans.notes: English edition. Annual maintenance and support is $3,999 and is charged separately from the second year.

plans.name: Perpetual, 200 administrators and 1,000 keys
plans.notes: English edition. Annual maintenance and support is $24,999.

hiddenCosts: Onboarding services are sold separately: online training costs $995 to $1,995, online onboarding with implementation costs $2,495 to $4,495, and onsite packages cost $4,999 to $9,999.
Additional application gateways beyond the one bundled with each license need a quote from sales.
Perpetual licenses carry yearly maintenance and support from the second year.
The pricing page uses a dollar sign without naming the currency. We record the figures as US dollars.
